name: Icon
description: SVG renderer for the Rayden icon set. Pass exactly one of name (dynamic registry lookup) or icon (static IconRecord data). Discover exact names and data exports through iconCatalog.

name.description: Exact registry name; use name or icon, never both. Name lookup loads after mounting.

size.description: xs=12, sm=16, md=20, lg=24, xl=32; or a custom pixel number.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for styling (use for color)

icon.description: Static icon data from @raydenui/ui/icons. Use instead of name for immediate and server rendering.

color.description: CSS color value. Omit to inherit text color; semantic styling can use className.

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Decorative by default. Label an icon-only button on the button. A meaningful standalone icon requires aria-hidden={false}, role="img", and aria-label.

commonMistakes.correction: Use name="heart" for registry strings, or icon={heartIcon} for data.
Provide name or icon. For meaningful standalone graphics also set aria-hidden={false} and role="img".

examples.title: Static data (immediate rendering)
